title: Plumbers in Tel Aviv compared by hours, areas and services
intro: This table compares eight plumbing businesses listed on Google Maps for 'plumber in Tel Aviv' on 25 November 2026, excluding sponsored listings. For each business it records the opening hours shown on Google Maps and, where the business publishes its own website, the services, service areas, experience, licence claims and prices that the website itself states. Fields are left empty when neither the Maps listing nor the business's own website states the fact; no ratings or reviews are included.

businesses.name: אורן רדה: אינסטלטור בתל אביב (Oren Rada: Plumber in Tel Aviv)
businesses.address: Ben Yehuda 246, Tel Aviv (stated on the website; the Google Maps listing shows no street address)
businesses.hours: Google Maps: Open, closes 10:30 pm. Website: '24/7 availability including nights, Shabbat and holidays'
services: drain blockages (sinks, toilets, showers, bathtubs, sewer lines)
leak repair incl. toilets and cisterns
solar water heater repair, replacement and electrical work
sewage jetting and sewer line / pit restoration
businesses.since: Website states 'over 30 years of experience' and 'second generation of plumbers'; no founding year given
businesses.licence: Website states 'each member of our team is a certified plumber' (no licence number or certifying body given)
businesses.prices: No prices or call-out fee published; website states 'committed to a fair price'
businesses.note: Website phone matches the Google Maps listing (072-392-6556); the site also lists a WhatsApp number and email.

businesses.name: מאור - אינסטלטור בתל אביב (Maor - Plumber in Tel Aviv)
businesses.address: Weizmann St 7, Tel Aviv (Google Maps; the website states no address)
businesses.hours: Google Maps: Open 24 hours. Website: '24 hours a day' and round-the-clock emergency availability; the website's price-list page states Friday and holiday eves until one hour before Shabbat, closed on Shabbat and holidays, and a night tariff from 19:00
services: pipe replacement by bypass method without breaking floors
drain unclogging (toilet, sink, shower, sewer line), electric snaking
sanitary fixture installation and faucet replacement
concealed cistern repair (Geberit, Schwab, Plasson, Grohe, SANIT, JOMO)
bidet seat installation in concealed cisterns
solar water heater and collector replacement
electric water heater: thermostat, heating element, flange and tank cleaning, timer installation
areas: Gush Dan and the central region (website wording)
businesses.since: Website states '40 years of family experience'; no founding year given (site footer copyright 2001-2026)
businesses.licence: Website states 'certified and experienced professionals' and 'full warranty on the work' (no licence number or certifying body given)
businesses.prices: Website price list (ranges, VAT not stated): plumber visit 250-350 ILS (diagnosis fee offset against the work); concealed cistern leak repair 450-850; regular cistern/toilet leak repair 350-750; kitchen faucet replacement 450-750; bathtub faucet replacement 400-750; toilet clog 350-550; kitchen or shower clog 350-550; root clog in sewer line 950-2,500; sewer camera inspection 850-1,500; thermal-camera leak detection 1,200-1,900; exposed pipe burst repair 550-950; concealed pipe burst repair 850-2,200; water heater diagnosis 350-550; thermostat replacement 350-550; heating element incl. flange 650-950; solar heater leak repair 450-850. Final quote given on site before work; night surcharge from 19:00
businesses.note: Website phone matches the Google Maps listing (052-705-8008); services from https://maor-sos.co.il/, areas from https://maor-sos.co.il/service-areas/ and https://maor-sos.co.il/plumber-in-the-center/. The site brands itself 'Maor SOS' and also lists 054-507-0928.
